errors.evidence: The y-axis range in the figure extends to 1, not 0.8.
The tallest bars (STS Corr. for Supervised_SimCSE and 2-Tier SimCSE) reach just above 0.9, not 0.82.
The color for Sentiment Accuracy in the figure is light yellow, not beige, though this is a reasonable synonym.
The description does not explicitly state that the tallest bars (STS Corr. for Supervised_SimCSE and 2-Tier SimCSE) reach just above 0.9.
The description omits the tick interval of 0.2 on the y-axis, though it is mentioned in the reference.
The description incorrectly states the models are listed in a specific order, while the atom and image show no specific sorting order.
